Three people stand on blue platforms: the host on the left, a woman in a brown patterned tube top in the middle, and a woman in a green dress on the right. Behind them is a large colorful screen displaying game categories. (3) The middle woman performs a punching motion and a dance. On the screen, an image of cream puffs is shown inside a red box. (7) A second male contestant in a black T-shirt and a third female contestant in denim join the group. They stand on the striped floor area of the studio, laughing and interacting with the host who holds a microphone. (8) The host returns to a close-up shot, speaking to the camera before cutting back to the full stage view where a picture of Chef A-chi is shown on the screen. The middle woman guesses correctly, pointing at the screen while the host confirms the answer. (11) The entire group of five people stands on stage, waving and making hand signs toward the camera as the show ends. Confetti-like graphics appear in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The host introduces the segment with a high-pitched, fast-paced, and extremely energetic tone. An upbeat, electronic dance-style BGM plays in the background with a steady 4/4 beat. (2) Transitions are marked by sharp 'whoosh' SFX. A female voice shouts '小' (Little) with high arousal, followed by laughter and more shouting of words as the game starts. (3) Every correct guess is punctuated by a bright 'Ding' bell SFX and synthesized applause tracks. The BGM remains consistent and driving. (4) The female contestant's voice exhibits high pitch variability as she reacts playfully to the snacks. Multiple voices overlap in a chaotic but joyful way. (5) During the chef-guessing segment, the vocal tone shifts slightly to mock-frustration, with 'Pass' graphics accompanied by short, comedic buzzer-like sound artifacts. (6) The final phase features collective cheering and a swelling of the BGM volume as the host closes the segment. High-arousal vocal outbursts from all participants create a festive studio atmosphere.
